# Sitra

> > Finland's innovation fund advancing societal wellbeing and sustainable economic growth through foresight, funding, and strategic leadership development.

Sitra is a state-funded foundation that combines foresight research, innovation funding, and leadership training to shape Finland's future. The organization publishes megatrends analysis, conducts weak signals monitoring, and supports transformative projects in areas like public sector productivity and sustainable economics.

## Key Topics

- Foresight and trend analysis
- Megatrends 2026
- Economic growth and sustainability
- Public sector productivity
- Artificial intelligence
- Innovation funding
- Weak signals monitoring
- Future Barometer
- Growth Atlas
- EU futures
- Leadership development
- Environmental scanning
- Finland
- Sustainable economy
- Future thinking

## Foresight & Trend Analysis

- [Ennakointi - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi): Sitra foresight hub: megatrends, future barometer, weak signals analysis
- [Megatrendit 2026 - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/megatrendit): Megatrends 2026: global development trends from Finland's perspective
- [Tulevaisuusbarometri 2025 - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/tulevaisuusbarometri): Future Barometer 2025: Finnish citizens' outlook on future hopes and anxieties
- [Heikot signaalit - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/heikot-signaalit): Weak signals foresight tool for identifying emerging trends and changes
- [Ennakointikatsaukset - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/ennakointikatsaukset): Foresight reports on EU opportunities, security, and economic change
- [Toimintaympäristökatsaukset - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/toimintaymparistokatsaukset): Operating environment analysis: quarterly strategic intelligence reports
- [Väestöennusteet ja talouden tulevaisuus - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/vaestoennusteet-ja-talouden-tulevaisuus): Population forecasts and economic future: demographics and workforce trends

## Strategic Projects

- [Työt alla nyt - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/aiheet): Sitra current projects: Growth Atlas, AI, public sector productivity initiatives
- [Kasvuatlas - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/projektit/kasvuatlas): Growth Atlas project: sustainable economic growth strategy for Finland
- [Tuottavuutta julkiselle sektorille - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/tuottavuutta-julkiselle-sektorille): Public sector productivity: AI transformation and leadership development program

## Leadership Training

- [Koulutukset - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/koulutukset): Sitra leadership training programs in sustainable economics and EU futures
- [Euroopan unionin tulevaisuuden johtamiskoulutus - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/koulutukset/euroopan-unionin-tulevaisuuden-johtamiskoulutus): EU Future Leadership training for Finnish decision-makers and executives
- [Kestävän talouspoliitikan johtamiskoulutus - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/ennakointi/koulutukset/kestavan-talouspoliitikan-johtamiskoulutus): Sustainable economics leadership training for government and policy leaders

## Funding & Support

- [Hae rahoitusta - Sitra](https://www.sitra.fi/hae-rahoitusta): Apply for Sitra funding: innovation grants and societal challenge support
